en.s: The Battle of Siffin (Arabic: معركة صفّين, romanized: Maʿraka Ṣiffīn) was fought in 657 CE (37 AH) between the forces of the fourth Rashidun caliph Ali ibn Abi Talib and the forces of the Umayyad governor of Syria, Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan. The battle is named after its location Siffin on the banks of the Euphrates river.
en.n: First Fitna: In the Battle of Siffin, troops led by Ali ibn Abu Talib clash with those led by Muawiyah I.

zh.s: 西芬战役（阿拉伯语：معركة صفّين，转写：Maʿraka Ṣiffīn）于公元657年（伊斯兰历37年）发生，交战双方为第四任正统哈里发阿里·伊本·阿比·塔利卜的部队和倭马亚王朝叙利亚总督穆阿维叶·伊本·阿比·苏富扬的部队。战役以其发生地西芬命名，该地位于幼发拉底河岸。
zh.n: 第一次伊斯兰内战：西芬战役中，阿里·伊本·阿比·塔利卜率领的部队与穆阿维叶一世率领的部队交战。

en.s: The Battle of Pliska or Battle of Vărbitsa Pass was a series of battles between the forces of the Byzantine Empire under Emperor Nicephorus I, and the First Bulgarian Empire under Khan Krum in July 811. The Byzantines plundered and burned the Bulgar capital Pliska which gave time for the Bulgarians to block passes in the Balkan Mountains that served as exits out of Bulgaria. The final battle took place on 26 July 811, in some of the passes in the eastern part of the Balkans, most probably the Vărbitsa Pass.

zh.s: 普利斯卡战役又称瓦尔比察山口战役，是公元811年7月拜占庭帝国与第一保加利亚帝国之间的一系列战斗。拜占庭军队由皇帝尼基弗鲁斯一世率领，保加利亚军队由可汗克鲁姆率领。拜占庭军队劫掠并焚毁保加利亚首都普利斯卡，使保加利亚人得以封锁巴尔干山脉中通往国外的山口。最终战役于811年7月26日在巴尔干山脉东部的某个山口进行，最可能是瓦尔比察山口。

en.s: The Battle of Valdejunquera took place in a valley called Iuncaria (Spanish: val de Junquera) on 26 July 920 between the Islamic Emirate of Córdoba and the Christian armies of the kingdoms of León and Pamplona. The battle, a victory for the Córdobans, was part of the "Campaign of Muez" (Campaña de Muez), which was directed primarily against León's southern line of defence, the County of Castile along the Duero river.

zh.s: 巴尔德洪克拉战役于920年7月26日在名为伊乌恩卡里亚的山谷（西班牙语：val de Junquera）发生，交战双方是科尔多瓦埃米尔国与莱昂和潘普洛纳王国的基督教军队。科尔多瓦军获胜。战役属于“穆埃斯战役行动”的一部分，该行动主要针对莱昂南部防线及杜罗河沿岸的卡斯蒂利亚伯国。

en.s: On 26 July 1184, in the German city of Erfurt, approximately sixty local nobles died when the floor of a building collapsed through the ground floor and into the latrine cesspit below. They were attending a Hoftag ("court day") conducted by King Henry VI when their combined weight caused the floor of the building to collapse. Some of the attendees drowned in human waste after falling into the cesspit.

zh.t: 爱尔福特厕所坍塌事故
zh.s: 1184年7月26日，德国爱尔福特一栋建筑的楼板坍塌，约60名当地贵族从底层坠入下方的厕所粪坑身亡。当时他们正在参加由国王亨利六世主持的宫廷会议，众人重量导致楼板坍塌。部分与会者坠入粪坑后溺于污物。

en.s: The Battle of Saint-Omer, fought on 26 July 1340, was a major engagement in the early stages of the Hundred Years' War, during Edward III's 1340 summer campaign against France launched from Flanders. The campaign was initiated in the aftermath of the English naval victory at the Battle of Sluys but was far less successful than Edward had hoped.

zh.s: 圣奥梅尔战役于1340年7月26日发生，是百年战争初期的一场重要战斗，属于爱德华三世从佛兰德斯发起的1340年夏季对法战役。这场战役行动在英军赢得斯吕斯海战后展开，但整体进展远不如爱德华所愿。

en.s: The Battle of Caen was an assault conducted on 26 July 1346 by forces from the Kingdom of England, led by King Edward III, on the French-held town of Caen and Normandy as a part of the Hundred Years' War. The assault was part of the Chevauchée of Edward III, which had started a month earlier when the English landed in Normandy.

zh.s: 1346年7月26日，英格兰国王爱德华三世率军进攻由法国控制的卡昂镇及诺曼底地区，这是百年战争中的一次军事行动。此次进攻是爱德华三世长途劫掠行动的一部分；一个月前，英军已在诺曼底登陆。

en.s: The Crécy campaign was a series of large-scale raids (chevauchées) conducted by the Kingdom of England throughout northern France in 1346 that devastated the French countryside on a wide front, culminating in the Battle of Crécy. The campaign was part of the Hundred Years' War. The campaign began on 12 July 1346, with the landing of English troops in Normandy, and ended with the capitulation of Calais on 3 August 1347.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 克雷西战役是英格兰王国于1346年在法国北部发动的一系列大规模袭击（chevauchées），沿线摧毁了法国乡村，最终爆发克雷西战役。该军事行动属于百年战争的一部分。战役于1346年7月12日英军在诺曼底登陆后开始，直到1347年8月3日加莱投降才结束。

en.s: The Battle of Valea Albă or Battle of Războieni or Battle of Akdere was an important event in the medieval history of Moldavia. It took place at Războieni, also known as Valea Albă, on July 26, 1476, between the Moldavian army of Ştefan cel Mare and an invading Ottoman army which was commanded personally by the Sultan Mehmed II.

zh.s: 瓦莱亚阿尔巴战役又称勒兹博耶尼战役或阿克代尔战役，是摩尔达维亚中世纪史上的重要事件。1476年7月26日，斯特凡大公率领的摩尔达维亚军队与苏丹穆罕默德二世亲自指挥的奥斯曼入侵军，在勒兹博耶尼（又称瓦莱亚阿尔巴）交战。

en.s: The battle that took place on 26 July 1566 during the Northern Seven Years' War and was a slight victory for a Swedish fleet over a combined Danish and Lübecker fleet. It began just east of Öland and the Allied fleet eventually retreated toward Gotland. Two days after the battle a storm sank fourteen of the Allied ships while they were anchored near Visby, drowning around 5900 men.

zh.s: 北方七年战争期间，瑞典舰队于1566年7月26日在厄兰岛以东与丹麦和吕贝克联合舰队交战，并取得小胜。战斗结束后，盟军舰队向哥特兰岛方向撤退。两天后，一场风暴导致停泊在维斯比附近的14艘盟军舰船沉没，约5900人溺亡。

en.t: Battle of Vila Franca do Campo
en.s: The naval Battle of Vila Franca do Campo, also known as Battle of Ponta Delgada and Naval Battle of Terceira Island, took place on 26 July 1582, off the coast of the island of São Miguel in the Portuguese archipelago of the Azores, during the War of the Portuguese Succession.

zh.t: 维拉弗兰卡-杜坎普战役
zh.s: 维拉弗兰卡-杜坎普海战又称蓬塔德尔加达海战或特塞拉岛海战，于1582年7月26日在葡萄牙亚速尔群岛圣米格尔岛近海发生，是葡萄牙王位继承战争的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of the Barbary Coast was a minor naval engagement that took place off in the Barbary Coast not far from the Gibraltar Strait, on July 26, 1592 during the Anglo-Spanish War. The hard fought action by an English merchant galleon in the Amity of London captained by Thomas White resulted in the capture of two Spanish ships which included a galleon despite them being outnumbered four to one.

zh.s: 巴巴里海岸海战是英西战争期间的一次小规模海战，于1592年7月26日在直布罗陀海峡附近的巴巴里海岸近海发生。英国商船“伦敦友谊号”由托马斯·怀特船长指挥，尽管兵力以四比一处于劣势，仍经过激战俘获两艘西班牙船，其中包括一艘大帆船。

en.s: The Battle of Kaiyuan was a conflict between the Later Jin and Ming dynasty in the summer of 1619. Following the victory at the Battle of Sarhu, Nurhaci continued the attack on Ming by assaulting the city of Kaiyuan. The Jin attack occurred during a heavy downpour. Ming dispatched a small relief contingent of 100 men, but they were intercepted by a Jin force and suffered 32 casualties.

zh.s: 开原之战是后金与明朝于1619年夏季发生的一场冲突。萨尔浒之战获胜后，努尔哈赤继续进攻明朝，转而攻打开原城。后金进攻时正值暴雨。明军派出一支100人的小规模援军，但遭后金军拦截，伤亡32人。

en.s: The storming of Bristol took place from 23 to 26 July 1643, during the First English Civil War. The Royalist army under Prince Rupert captured the important port of Bristol from its weakened Parliamentarian garrison. The city remained under Royalist control until the second siege of Bristol in September 1645.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次英国内战期间，保王派军队于1643年7月23日至26日围攻布里斯托尔。鲁珀特亲王率领保王派军队，从防守薄弱的议会派守军手中攻占了这座重要港口。此后城市一直由保王派控制，直至1645年9月第二次布里斯托尔围城战。

en.s: Battle of Skalat was a battle fought between the Tatar and Transylvanian armies as part of the Deluge.

zh.s: 斯卡拉特战役是特兰西瓦尼亚军队与鞑靼军队在“大洪水”战争期间进行的一场战斗。

en.s: Battle of Kaniv (Russian: Каневское сражение, romanized: Kanevskoe srazhenie), was a battle during the summer campaign in the left-bank of Ukraine of Yuri Khmelnitsky, between the Cossack-Polish troops and the Russian-Cossack army led by Yakym Somko and Grigory Romodanovsky. The battle ended with a crushing defeat for Yuri Khmelnitsky and the hetman's retreat to right-bank Ukraine.

zh.s: 卡尼夫战役（俄语：Каневское сражение，转写：Kanevskoe srazhenie）发生于尤里·赫梅利尼茨基在乌克兰左岸发起的夏季战役期间，交战双方是哥萨克—波兰联军和雅基姆·索姆科、格里戈里·罗曼诺夫斯基率领的俄国—哥萨克联军。尤里·赫梅利尼茨基一方惨败，盖特曼撤退至乌克兰右岸。

en.s: The Battle of Santa Vittoria was an encounter battle or skirmish in the Italian region of Emilia-Romagna on 26 July 1702 during the War of the Spanish Succession between a French force under Louis Joseph, duc de Vendôme and an Imperial cavalry detachment under General Annibal Visconti.

zh.s: 圣维托里亚战役是西班牙王位继承战争期间的一次遭遇战或小规模冲突，于1702年7月26日在意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅地区发生。交战双方是路易-约瑟夫·德·旺多姆公爵率领的法军和安尼巴莱·维斯孔蒂将军率领的帝国骑兵分队。

en.s: The history of women's cricket can be traced back to a report in The Reading Mercury on 26 July 1745 and a match that took place between the villages of Bramley and Hambledon near Guildford in Surrey. The Mercury reported: "The greatest cricket match that was played in this part of England was on Friday, the 26th of last month, on Gosden Common, near Guildford, between eleven maids of Bramley and eleven maids of Hambledon, all dressed in white. The Bramley maids had blue ribbons and the Hambledon maids red ribbons on their heads. The Bramley girls got 119 notches and the Hambledon girls 127.

zh.s: 女子板球的历史可追溯至1745年7月26日《雷丁信使报》的一则报道；报道介绍了萨里郡吉尔福德附近布拉姆利村和汉布尔登村之间的一场比赛。《信使报》写道：“英格兰这一带最精彩的板球赛于上月26日星期五在吉尔福德附近的戈斯登公地举行，由布拉姆利村11名姑娘对阵汉布尔登村11名姑娘，她们都穿着白衣。布拉姆利姑娘头戴蓝色缎带，汉布尔登姑娘头戴红色缎带。布拉姆利队得119分，汉布尔登队得127分……”

en.s: The Battle of Hastenbeck (26 July 1757) was fought as part of the Invasion of Hanover during the Seven Years' War between the allied forces of Hanover, Hesse-Kassel (or Hesse-Cassel) and Brunswick, and the French. The allies were defeated by the French army near Hamelin in the Electorate of Hanover.

zh.s: 哈斯滕贝克战役于1757年7月26日发生，是七年战争期间汉诺威战役的一部分。汉诺威、黑森-卡塞尔（或黑森-卡塞尔）和不伦瑞克组成的盟军与法国交战，最终在汉诺威选侯国哈默尔恩附近被法军击败。

en.s: The siege of Louisbourg (8 June – 26 July 1758) was fought during the Seven Years' War on Cape Breton Island between an attacking British force and defending French and Mi'kmaq troops. The French attempted to send reinforcements by sea, but were not able to as the fleet was blockaded and defeated by the British.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 路易斯堡围城战于1758年6月8日至7月26日在布雷顿角岛进行，属于七年战争的一部分。进攻方为英国军队，防守方为法国军队和米克马克人。法军试图从海上派遣援军，但英国舰队实施封锁并将其击败，援军未能抵达。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Niagara was a siege late in the French and Indian War, the North American theatre of the Seven Years' War. The British siege of Fort Niagara in July 1759 was part of a campaign to remove French control of the Great Lakes and Ohio Valley regions, making possible a western invasion of the French province of Canada in conjunction with General James Wolfe's invasion to the east.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 尼亚加拉堡战役是法国和印第安人战争后期的一场围城战，该战争是七年战争在北美的战场。1759年7月，英军围攻尼亚加拉堡，作为一项行动的一部分，旨在消除法国对五大湖和俄亥俄河谷地区的控制，从而为从西面入侵加拿大法国殖民地创造条件，并配合詹姆斯·沃尔夫将军从东面发起的入侵。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Glatz took place in 1760 during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War) when an Austrian force led by General von Laudon laid siege to and successfully stormed the fortress of Glatz (today Kłodzko, Poland) from its Prussian garrison. On 6 June Laudon surrounded Glatz, but he had to wait until heavy artillery was brought from Olomouc in neighbouring Moravia.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1760年第三次西里西亚战争（七年战争的一部分）期间，劳东将军率领奥地利军队围攻并成功攻占格拉茨要塞。要塞由普鲁士驻军防守，现名为克沃兹科，位于波兰。劳东于6月6日包围格拉茨，但必须等到从邻近的摩拉维亚奥洛穆茨运来重炮后才能行动。

en.s: The Second Continental Congress (1775–1781) was the meeting of delegates from the Thirteen Colonies that united in support of the American Revolution and Revolutionary War, which established American independence from Great Britain. The Congress constituted a new federation that it first named the United Colonies of North America, and in 1776, renamed the United States of America.
en.n: The office that would later become the United States Post Office Department is established by the Second Continental Congress. Benjamin Franklin of Pennsylvania takes office as Postmaster General.

zh.s: 第二届大陆会议（1775—1781年）由十三个殖民地派出的代表组成，他们团结支持美国革命和独立战争，最终促成美国脱离大不列颠独立。会议建立了一个新的联邦，最初称为“北美联合殖民地”，1776年改名为“美利坚合众国”。
zh.n: 后来发展为美国邮政署的机构由第二届大陆会议设立。来自宾夕法尼亚州的本杰明·富兰克林就任邮政总长。

en.t: The Surrey Iron Railway, arguably the world's first public railway, opens in south London, United Kingdom
en.s: The Surrey Iron Railway (SIR) was a horse-drawn narrow-gauge plateway that linked Wandsworth and Croydon via Mitcham, all then in Surrey but now suburbs of south London, in England. It was established by an act of Parliament in 1801, and opened partly in 1802 and partly in 1803. It was a toll railway on which carriers used horse traction.

zh.s: 萨里铁道（SIR）是一条由马拉动的窄轨板式铁路，经由米奇姆连接万兹沃思和克罗伊登。这些地点当时都在萨里郡，如今已成为英格兰伦敦南部的郊区。铁路于1801年经议会法案批准设立，部分路段于1802年、其余部分于1803年开通。这是一条收费铁路，运输公司使用马匹牵引车辆。

en.s: The action of 26 July 1806 was the first naval engagement of the Java campaign of 1806–1807. Fought off the southern coast of Celebes in the Dutch East Indies, the battle saw a Royal Navy squadron led by Captain Edward Elphinstone attack and capture a valuable Dutch convoy under Captain Nicolaas Sebastiaan Aalbers.

zh.s: 1806年7月26日的海战是1806—1807年爪哇战役中的首次海上交战，地点在荷属东印度群岛西里伯斯岛（今苏拉威西岛）南岸近海。爱德华·埃尔芬斯通上校率领的英国皇家海军分舰队袭击并俘获了尼古拉斯·塞巴斯蒂安·阿尔伯斯船长率领的一支重要荷兰护航船队。

en.s: The Swedish–Norwegian War was a war fought between Sweden and Norway in the summer of 1814. According to the Treaty of Kiel, Norway would enter a union with Sweden under Charles XIII of Sweden. The war resulted in Norway being forced into the United Kingdoms of Sweden and Norway, but with its own constitution and parliament.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 瑞典—挪威战争是1814年夏季瑞典与挪威之间的一场战争。根据《基尔条约》，挪威将与瑞典国王卡尔十三世领导的瑞典组成联盟。战争结束后，挪威被迫加入瑞典和挪威联合王国，但保留了自己的宪法和议会。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Dervenakia (Greek: Μάχη των Δερβενακίων) was the Greek victory over the Ottoman forces on 26–28 July 1822, an important event in the Greek War of Independence. The destruction of Dramali Pasha's forces saved the heartland of the rebellion, the Morea, and secured it for the Greeks until the arrival of Ibrahim Pasha in 1825.

zh.s: 德尔韦纳基亚战役（希腊语：Μάχη των Δερβενακίων）是希腊独立战争期间的一场重要战役。希腊军队于1822年7月26日至28日击败奥斯曼军队，摧毁德拉马利帕夏的部队，保住叛乱核心地区摩里亚，直到1825年易卜拉欣帕夏到来前，该地区一直由希腊人控制。

en.s: The July Revolution (French: Révolution de Juillet), also known as the French Revolution of 1830, Second French Revolution, or les Trois Glorieuses ("the Three Glorious [Days]"), was a second French Revolution after the first of 1789–99. It led to the overthrow of King Charles X, the French Bourbon monarch, and the ascent of his cousin Louis Philippe, Duke of Orléans, who governed for 18 years as the last king of France.

en.s: The University of Wisconsin–Madison (University of Wisconsin, Wisconsin, UW, UW–Madison, or simply Madison) is a public land-grant research university in Madison, Wisconsin, United States. It was founded in 1848 when Wisconsin achieved statehood and is the flagship campus of the University of Wisconsin System. The 933-acre (378 ha) main campus is located on the shores of Lake Mendota; the university also owns and operates a 1,200-acre (486 ha) arboretum 4 miles (6.4 km) south of the main campus.

en.s: The Battle of Salineville occurred July 26, 1863, near Salineville, Ohio during Morgan's Raid in the American Civil War. It was one of the northernmost military actions involving the Confederate States Army. The Union victory shattered John Hunt Morgan's remaining Confederate cavalry and led to his capture later that day.

en.s: The Battle of Dead Buffalo Lake was a skirmish in July 1863 in Dakota Territory between United States army forces and Santee, Yankton, Yanktonai and Teton Sioux. The Sioux attempted to capture the pack train of the army and retired from the field when they were unsuccessful.

en.s: Morgan's Raid (also the Calico Raid or Great Raid of 1863) was a diversionary incursion by Confederate cavalry into the Union states of Indiana, Ohio, and West Virginia during the American Civil War. The raid took place from June 11 to July 26, 1863. It is named for the commander of the Confederate troops, Brigadier General John Hunt Morgan. Although it caused temporary alarm in the North, the raid failed.
en.n: American Civil War: Morgan's Raid ends; At Salineville, Ohio, Confederate cavalry leader John Hunt Morgan and 360 of his volunteers are captured by Union forces.

zh.s: 摩根突袭又称“印花布突袭”或“1863年大突袭”，是美国内战期间邦联骑兵对联邦州印第安纳、俄亥俄和西弗吉尼亚发动的一次牵制性入侵，时间为1863年6月11日至7月26日。行动以邦联部队指挥官、准将约翰·亨特·摩根命名。突袭一度令北方人恐慌，但最终以失败告终。
zh.n: 美国内战：摩根突袭结束；在俄亥俄州萨利恩维尔，邦联骑兵指挥官约翰·亨特·摩根及其360名志愿兵被联邦军俘虏。

en.s: The Battle of Platte Bridge, also called the Battle of Platte Bridge Station, on July 26, 1865 was the culmination of a summer offensive by the Lakota Sioux and Cheyenne Indians against the United States army. In May and June the Indians raided army outposts and stagecoach stations over a wide swath of Wyoming and Montana. In July, they assembled a large army, estimated by Cheyenne warrior George Bent to number 3,000 warriors, and descended upon Platte Bridge. The bridge, across the North Platte River near present-day Casper, Wyoming, was guarded by 120 soldiers.

zh.s: 普拉特桥战役又称普拉特桥站战役，发生于1865年7月26日，是拉科塔苏族和夏延人当年夏季对美国陆军发动攻势的高潮。5月和6月，原住民在怀俄明和蒙大拿广大地区袭击陆军哨所和驿站。7月，他们集结了一支大军；据夏延战士乔治·本特估计，人数达3000人，并向普拉特桥推进。这座横跨北普拉特河的桥梁位于今怀俄明州卡斯珀附近，由120名士兵守卫。

en.s: The Battle of Versa took place on the 26 July 1866 during the Third Italian War of Independence in the Italian unification process. The Italian army, jointly commanded by Alberto La Forest de Divonne, defeated the Austrian army guarding the crossing of the Torre river at Ponte di Versa, present-day fraction of Romans d'Isonzo in the province of Gorizia. This marked the maximum Italian advance into Friuli.

zh.s: 韦尔萨战役于1866年7月26日发生在意大利第三次独立战争期间，也是意大利统一进程的一部分。由阿尔贝托·拉福雷斯·德·迪冯共同指挥的意大利军队，击败了守卫托雷河蓬特迪韦尔萨渡口的奥地利军队。该地今为戈里齐亚省罗马恩斯德伊松佐市镇的一部分。这标志着意军在弗留利地区推进到最远处。

en.t: The Republic of Stellaland is founded in Southern Africa
en.s: The Republic of Stellaland (Dutch: Republiek Stellaland) was a Boer republic located in an area of British Bechuanaland (now in South Africa's North West Province), west of the Transvaal. It served as a Boer republic from 1882 to 1883. After unification with the neighbouring State of Goshen, it became the United States of Stellaland (Dutch: Verenigde Staten van Stellaland) from 1883 until 1885, when it was abolished and annexed by the British.

zh.t: 斯特拉兰共和国在非洲南部成立
zh.s: 斯特拉兰共和国（荷兰语：Republiek Stellaland）是一个布尔人共和国，位于英属贝专纳兰地区（今南非西北省），地处德兰士瓦以西。该共和国存在于1882年至1883年。与邻近的戈申国合并后，它于1883年至1885年改称斯特拉兰合众国（荷兰语：Verenigde Staten van Stellaland），随后被英国废除并吞并。

en.t: Premiere of Richard Wagner's opera Parsifal at Bayreuth
en.s: Parsifal (WWV 111) is a music drama in three acts by the German composer Richard Wagner and his last composition. Wagner's own libretto for the work is freely based on the 13th-century Middle High German chivalric romance Parzival of the Minnesänger Wolfram von Eschenbach and the Old French chivalric romance Perceval ou le Conte du Graal by the 12th-century trouvère Chrétien de Troyes, recounting different accounts of the story of the Arthurian knight Parzival (Percival) and his spiritual quest for the Holy Grail.

zh.t: 理查德·瓦格纳歌剧《帕西法尔》在拜罗伊特首演
zh.s: 《帕西法尔》（WWV 111）是德国作曲家理查德·瓦格纳创作的三幕音乐剧，也是他的最后一部作品。瓦格纳为该剧创作的剧本主要取材于13世纪中高地德语吟游诗人沃尔夫拉姆·冯·埃申巴赫的骑士传奇《帕尔齐法尔》，以及12世纪古法语游吟诗人克雷蒂安·德·特鲁瓦的骑士传奇《珀西瓦尔或圣杯故事》，讲述亚瑟王骑士帕尔齐法尔（珀西瓦尔）的不同经历及其追寻圣杯的灵性旅程。

en.s: The Revolution of the Park (Revolución del Parque), also known as the Revolution of '90, was an uprising against the national government of Argentina that took place on July 26, 1890 and started with the takeover of the Buenos Aires Artillery Park. It was led by members of the Civic Union (which would later give rise to the modern Radical Civic Union) against the presidency of Miguel Juárez Celman (of the National Autonomist Party). Though it failed in its main goals, the revolution forced Juárez Celman's resignation and marked the decline of the elite of the Generation of '80.

zh.s: 公园革命（西班牙语：Revolución del Parque）又称“90年革命”，是1890年7月26日发生的一场反对阿根廷中央政府的起义，起事者首先占领了布宜诺斯艾利斯炮兵公园。起义由公民联盟成员领导，该联盟后来发展为现代激进公民联盟。起义反对民族自治党总统米格尔·华雷斯·塞尔曼。虽然未能实现主要目标，这场革命迫使塞尔曼辞职，也标志着“80年代一代”精英势力开始衰落。

en.t: Dadabhai Naoroji is elected as the first Indian Member of Parliament in Britain
en.s: Dadabhai Naoroji (4 September 1825 – 30 June 1917) was an Indian political leader, merchant, scholar, and writer who played a role in both Indian and British public life. He was among the founding members of the Indian National Congress and served as its President on three occasions, from 1886-87, 1893-94 and 1906-07. Naoroji's early career included serving as the Diwan of Baroda in 1874.

zh.s: 达达拜·瑙罗吉（1825年9月4日—1917年6月30日）是印度政治领袖、商人、学者和作家，在印度和英国公共事务中均发挥过作用。他是印度国民大会党创始成员之一，曾三度担任党主席，任期分别为1886—1887年、1893—1894年和1906—1907年。瑙罗吉早年于1874年担任巴罗达邦迪万。

en.s: The siege of Malakand was the 26 July – 2 August 1897 siege of the British garrison in the Malakand region of colonial British India's North West Frontier Province. en.s: The Potsdam Declaration or the Proclamation Defining Terms for Japanese Surrender is a statement that called for the surrender of all Japanese armed forces during World War II. On July 26, 1945, United States President Harry S. Truman, United Kingdom Prime Minister Winston Churchill, and Chairman of the Nationalist Government of China Chiang Kai-shek issued the document, which outlined the terms of surrender for the Empire of Japan as agreed upon at the Potsdam Conference. This ultimatum stated that, if Japan did not surrender, it would face "prompt and utter destruction."

zh.s: 波茨坦公告又称《规定日本投降条件的公告》，要求第二次世界大战中的日本武装部队全部投降。1945年7月26日，美国总统哈里·S·杜鲁门、英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔和中国国民政府主席蒋介石共同发布公告，列明波茨坦会议商定的日本投降条件。最后通牒警告，如果日本不投降，将面临“迅速而彻底的毁灭”。

en.t: U.S. president Harry S. Truman signs Executive Order 9981, desegregating the military of the United States
en.s: Executive Order 9981 was an executive order issued on July 26, 1948, by President Harry S. Truman. It abolished discrimination "on the basis of race, color, religion or national origin" in the United States Armed Forces. The order led to the re-integration of the services during the Korean War (1950–1953). It was a crucial event in the post–World War II civil rights movement and a major achievement of Truman's presidency.

zh.t: 杜鲁门总统签署9981号行政命令，废除美国军队中的种族隔离
zh.s: 哈里·S·杜鲁门总统于1948年7月26日发布9981号行政命令，禁止美国武装部队基于种族、肤色、宗教或国籍歧视。该命令促成了朝鲜战争期间（1950—1953年）各军种重新整合。这是二战后民权运动中的关键事件，也是杜鲁门总统任期内的一项重要成就。

en.s: Alice in Wonderland is a 1951 American animated musical fantasy comedy film produced by Walt Disney Productions and released by RKO Radio Pictures. The production was supervised by Ben Sharpsteen, and was directed by Clyde Geronimi, Wilfred Jackson, and Hamilton Luske.

en.t: King Farouk of Egypt abdicates in favor of his son Fuad
en.s: Farouk I (; Arabic: فاروق الأول, romanized: Fārūq al-Awwal; 11 February 1920 – 18 March 1965) was the tenth ruler of Egypt from the Muhammad Ali dynasty and the penultimate King of Egypt and the Sudan, succeeding his father, Fuad I, in 1936 and reigning until his overthrow in a military coup in 1952. en.s: General elections were held in Costa Rica on 26 July 1953. José Figueres Ferrer of the National Liberation Party won the presidential election, whilst his party also won the parliamentary election. Voter turnout was 67.2% in the presidential election and 67.5% in the parliamentary election. This was Costa Rica’s first election since the end of the 1948 Civil War and the democratic guarantees were not fully restored. José Figueres, the caudillo of the victorious National Liberation Army faction in the Civil War was candidate by the newly founded National Liberation Party (PLN).

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于1953年7月26日举行大选。民族解放党候选人何塞·菲格雷斯·费雷尔赢得总统选举，该党也赢得议会选举。总统选举投票率为67.2%，议会选举为67.5%。这是1948年内战结束后的首次选举，但民主保障尚未完全恢复。内战中获胜的民族解放军派别领袖何塞·菲格雷斯，代表新成立的民族解放党（PLN）参选。

en.s: The Cuban Revolution (Spanish: Revolución cubana) was the military and political movement that overthrew the dictatorship of Fulgencio Batista, who had ruled Cuba from 1952 to 1959. The revolution began after the 1952 Cuban coup d'état, in which Batista overthrew the emerging Cuban democracy and consolidated power. Among those who opposed the coup was Fidel Castro, then a young lawyer, who initially tried to challenge the takeover through legal means in the Cuban courts. When these efforts failed, Fidel Castro and his brother Raúl led an armed assault on the Moncada Barracks, a Cuban military post, on 26 July 1953.

zh.s: 古巴革命（西班牙语：Revolución cubana）是一场军事和政治运动，推翻了富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔的独裁统治；巴蒂斯塔于1952年至1959年统治古巴。革命在1952年古巴政变后开始，当时巴蒂斯塔推翻刚兴起的民主制度并巩固权力。反对政变者之一是年轻律师菲德尔·卡斯特罗，他最初试图通过古巴法院以法律手段挑战政变。法律途径失败后，菲德尔和弟弟劳尔率领武装人员于1953年7月26日袭击古巴军事据点蒙卡达兵营。

en.s: The Short Creek raid is the name given to the Arizona Department of Public Safety and Arizona National Guard action against Mormon fundamentalists that took place on the morning of July 26, 1953, at Short Creek, Arizona. The Short Creek raid was the largest mass arrest of polygamists in American history. At the time, it was described as "the largest mass arrest of men and women in modern American history."

en.s: Operation Sayasila (26 July 1971—31 October 1971) was a major offensive military operation of the Laotian Civil War. It was staged by command of King Sisavang Vatthana. Launched on 26 July 1971 against the Ho Chi Minh Trail complex and its People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) garrison, Sayasila was planned as a rather complex two phase operation dependent on coordinating two columns containing 4,400 troops with close air support in an attack on 1,100 Vietnamese Communist soldiers. When the assault stalled in mid-August, it was elaborated upon with two additional helilifts of Royalist troops behind the PAVN's mobile garrison.

en.s: Eelam War IV is the name given to the fourth phase of armed conflict between the Sri Lankan military and the separatist Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE), which is currently proscribed as a terrorist organisation by 32 countries. en.s: The 2008 Ahmedabad bombings were a series of 21 bomb blasts that hit Ahmedabad, India, on 26 July 2008, within a span of 70 minutes. 56 people were killed and over 200 people were injured. Ahmedabad is the cultural and commercial heart of Gujarat state, and a large part of western India. The blasts were considered to be of low intensity, and were similar to the Bangalore blasts, Karnataka which occurred the day before. Several TV channels said they had received an e-mail from a terror outfit called Indian Mujahideen claiming responsibility for the terror attacks; Islamic militant group Harkat-ul-Jihad-al-Islami, however, has claimed responsibility for the attacks.

en.s: The Boko Haram insurgency began in July 2009, when the militant Islamist and jihadist rebel group Boko Haram started an armed rebellion against the government of Nigeria. Boko Haram targets both Muslims and Christians. Attacks are often directed at individuals perceived as supporting the Nigerian government or Islamic State after the split between them, including civil servants, local defense groups, Muslim leaders who oppose the group and other rebels like al-Qaeda and Islamic State.

en.s: The 2009 Boko Haram uprising was a four-day armed conflict that took place from 26 to 29 July 2009 between the Islamist militant group Boko Haram and Nigerian security forces across several states in northeastern Nigeria. Fighting broke out in Bauchi before spreading to Maiduguri, Potiskum, and Wudil. Around 1,000 people were killed in total, with approximately 700 deaths recorded in Maiduguri alone.

zh.s: 2009年7月26日至29日，尼日利亚东北部多个州发生持续4天的武装冲突，交战双方为伊斯兰武装组织博科圣地和尼日利亚安全部队。战斗首先在包奇爆发，随后蔓延至迈杜古里、波蒂斯库姆和武迪尔。冲突共造成约1000人死亡，其中迈杜古里约有700人死亡。

en.t: 2011 Royal Moroccan Air Force C-130 crash
en.s: On 26 July 2011, a C-130 Hercules military transport aircraft operated by the Royal Moroccan Air Force crashed near Guelmim, Morocco, killing all 80 people on board. The plane was carrying 71 passengers (initially reported as 72), mostly members of the Moroccan Armed Forces, and nine crew. Three occupants were pulled alive from the wreckage but later died of their injuries.

zh.t: 2011年摩洛哥皇家空军C-130坠机事故
zh.s: 2011年7月26日，摩洛哥皇家空军一架C-130“大力神”军用运输机在摩洛哥盖勒敏附近坠毁，机上80人全部遇难。飞机载有71名乘客（最初报道为72人），大多是摩洛哥武装部队成员，以及9名机组人员。3名机上人员从残骸中被救出时仍然生还，但后来因伤势过重死亡。

en.s: The 2015 CONCACAF Gold Cup final decided the winners of the 2015 CONCACAF Gold Cup. It was held on July 26, 2015, at Lincoln Financial Field in Philadelphia, and contested by Jamaica and Mexico. It was Jamaica's first final of a CONCACAF championship, and Mexico's 12th; they won a record 10th with a 3–1 victory. It was also the first Gold Cup Final since 2003 not to feature the United States.

en.t: Hillary Clinton (pictured) became the first female nominee for president of the United States by a major political party at the Democratic National Convention in Philadelphia
en.s: Hillary Diane Rodham Clinton (née Rodham; born October 26, 1947) is an American politician, lawyer and diplomat. She was the 67th United States secretary of state in the administration of Barack Obama from 2009 to 2013, a U.S. senator representing New York from 2001 to 2009, and the first lady of the United States from 1993 to 2001 as the wife of Bill Clinton.

zh.t: 希拉里·克林顿在费城民主党全国代表大会上成为美国主要政党首位女性总统候选人
zh.s: 希拉里·黛安·罗德姆·克林顿（原姓罗德姆；1947年10月26日出生）是美国政治人物、律师和外交官。她于2009年至2013年在巴拉克·奥巴马政府中担任第67任美国国务卿，2001年至2009年担任代表纽约州的联邦参议员，并于1993年至2001年作为比尔·克林顿的妻子担任美国第一夫人。
